agent_discovery.description: Answer a bounded RGB-only visual question from one current camera frame through the configured vision-language router. Use this read-only Skill only when visible appearance is sufficient. It cannot satisfy requests to locate, measure, or report an item in 3D, metric, depth, world, camera, or robot coordinates; those requests require locate_item.
when_to_use: The user asks a visual question about the current camera scene.
A finite Skill needs one routed VLM interpretation with backend provenance.
when_not_to_use: The task requires metric depth, a registered 3D point, continuous tracking, or physical motion.

The user asks to locate, measure, position, or identify an object in 3D, depth, metric, world-frame, camera-frame, or robot-frame coordinates; use locate_item even when the request also asks what the object is.
Deterministic geometry or a non-VLM sensor can answer more reliably.
side_effects: Reads one current RGB frame from provider shared memory.
Calls one configured VLM backend, with ordered fallback on failure.

question.description: The complete bounded question about visible evidence.
